invariants.rationale: The method must return a non-null List<WriteStatus> to satisfy its contract and avoid NullPointerExceptions in callers.
The 'records' input should not be null for normal insert operations.
The 'instantTime' argument should be set for an insert operation since it represents the commit instant.
'result' is expected to be an instance of List as declared in the method signature.
If records were provided (non-empty), then the result should contain some WriteStatus entries; if no records, result may be empty as well.
